name: 19143 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19143 (Philadelphia) has 264 nonprofit organizations. 109 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 88 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (34% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19143 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 19143 (Philadelphia) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
